summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 by Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust reporting its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of April 30, 2026, along with component breakdowns and class-by-class NAV data. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The disclosure is a routine periodic NAV update common for non-traded REITs and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
